803-2638-3510-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2638-3510-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Vizier of Tumbling Sands or Kelpie Guide

1719-2085-7786.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
If Vizier of Tumbling Sands has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
If Kelpie Guide has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.

3525-4289-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

2104-5913-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak from exile to the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2976-3129-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2976-3129-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2811-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-3197-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

5796-6980-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
5796-6980-7737.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
5796-6980-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Starving Revenant and Stark's Ingenuity trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Resolve the first Stark's Ingenuity trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
5796-6980-7737.notes: With the additional Stark's Ingenuity trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

2173-2469-5220-6094.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-5319-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2921-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7415.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

5248-7299.description:
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
5248-7299.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

2231-2921-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-2921-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2919-3490-4050-4210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4050-4210.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Repeat from step 2.

1796-2060-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2556-3542-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2556-3542-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron
When Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2556-3542-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

3180-3394-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

678-2034-4826-6644.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {C}{C}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

222-997-4871-5221.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Sprouting Thrinax die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Sprouting Thrinax triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

213-2232-6016.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Life's Web has at least two divinity counters on it.
You have at least one other nonartifact creature card in hand.
213-2232-6016.description:
Activate Myojin of Life's Web by removing a divinity counter from it, putting Proud Pack-Rhino and another nonartifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Proud Pack-Rhino and the additional creature enter the battlefield, Bloom Hulk triggers once and Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the Proud Pack-Rhino trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Proud Pack-Rhino and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

654-2034-2653-5552.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
654-2034-2653-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

643-1636-4324.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1636-4324.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Workshop Elders triggers, causing Maskwood Nexus to become a 0/0 artifact creature, then putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2034-2773-3310-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-2773-3310-3490.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage to an opponent equal to the creature's power.
War Elemental's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

3045-4013-4813.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
3045-4013-4813.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R} that can only be spent as though it were colorless mana due to Celestial Dawn.
Repeat.

4-933-1367.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Hoarding Broodlord.
When Hoarding Broodlord enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library for Nexus of Fate if it's in your library, and exiling it.
Cast Nexus of Fate either from your hand or from exile by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

343-2757-5285.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic land.
You are the monarch.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
343-2757-5285.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {W}.
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Angel, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

1358-3272-3525-4289.notablePrerequisites: Immovable Rod does not have summoning sickness.
1358-3272-3525-4289.description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, making Immovable Rod a creature in addition to it's other types.
Cast Pemmin's Aura enchanting Immovable Rod.
Activate Immovable Rod by tapping it to add {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U} to untap Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-2382-4840.description:
Activate Mimic Vat, putting a token copy of Myr Battlesphere onto the battlefield.
The Myr Battlesphere Token triggers, creating four Myr tokens.
Activate Time Sieve, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the 4 Myr tokens, getting an extra turn.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
